H Partners Management LLC Lowered Holding in Six Flags Entmt Corp New (SIX) by $59.63 Million Posted by Hazel Jackson 44 pm
H Partners Management Llc decreased its stake in Six Flags Entmt Corp New (SIX) by 10.85% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. H Partners Management Llc sold 851,794 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.80% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 7.00 million shares of the services-misc. amusement & recreation company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $490.35M, down from 7.85M at the end of the previous reported quarter. H Partners Management Llc who had been investing in Six Flags Entmt Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.53% or $1.55 during the last trading session, reaching $59.81. About 1.88 million shares traded or 36.42% up from the average. Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE:SIX) has risen 26.97% uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.35% the S&P500.
H Partners Management Llc, which manages about $1.63 billion and $874.75 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Tempur Sealy Intl Inc (NYSE:TPX) by 688,800 shares to 8.00 million shares, valued at $384.40M in 2018Q2, according to the filing.
Analysts await Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE:SIX) to report earnings on February, 19. They expect $0.28 earnings per share, up 86.67 % or $0.13 from last year’s $0.15 per share. SIX’s profit will be $23.64M for 53.40 P/E if the $0.28 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.16 actual earnings per share reported by Six Flags Entertainment Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -87.04 % negative EPS growth.
